purpose: Check UTC format-6 timestamps across AmigaOS GUI and Linux in both transfer directions
timezone_under_test: Europe/Stockholm; fixture dates are in standard time (UTC+01:00)

emulator.name: FS-UAE
emulator.host_directory_volume: FS-UAE host-directory volume mounted as DH0:

gui_build.instrumentation_scope: Development logging enabled; archive behavior is the production Amiga GUI source.

amiga_gui_created_archive.linux_full_and_mini_integrity: Both readers verify all 8 physical entries.

linux_extraction.full_reader_result: All primary payload bytes match; Amiga native metadata reports partial.
linux_extraction.mini_reader_result: All primary payload bytes match; Amiga native metadata reports partial.

linux_created_archive.linux_full_and_mini_control_extracts: Both restore all four fixture mtimes exactly and preserve the payload hash.

amiga_gui_extract.result: GUI logged Extract complete rc=0; payload hash matches the fixture.

finding: In this Europe/Stockholm FS-UAE host-directory setup, the Amiga GUI writes format-6 times one hour ahead of the Linux fixture and applies Linux-created UTC times one hour behind on extraction. A same-Amiga GUI create/extract round trip can hide this offset because the two errors cancel.
scope_limit: This establishes the offset for one FS-UAE host-directory setup and one set of November timestamps. Native OFS/FFS behavior, other timezone offsets, daylight-saving transitions, and a portable Amiga timezone source are not yet qualified.
